description: Scans an exact keyword across all registered TLDs (over 1,400+ IANA extensions), extracts registration year and creation date, sorts all domains chronologically from oldest to newest, generates executive era metrics, and optionally exports complete results to a clean CSV spreadsheet.

csv_path.description: Optional custom file name or relative path inside current directory to save CSV (e.g. './apple_timeline.csv'). Path traversal is strictly sanitized.

export_csv.description: Whether to export the full results to a local CSV file (default: false). Recommended when auditing large datasets.

keyword.description: The exact core keyword to audit (e.g. 'openai', 'anthropic', 'apple', 'crypto')

limit.description: Max registered domains to inspect in detail (default: 1000).

max_year.description: Optional filter to include only domains registered in or before this year (e.g. 2005).

min_year.description: Optional filter to include only domains registered in or after this year (e.g. 1980).

probe_activity.description: Whether to probe live web activity for taken domains (default false for fastest timeline scan).

scope.description: 'all' for all 1,400+ IANA TLDs; 'popular' for top commercial extensions; 'gtld' for new gTLDs; 'cctld' for country codes.

sort_by.description: Sorting order: 'year_asc' (oldest year to newest, default), 'year_desc' (newest to oldest), or 'alphabetical'.

tlds.description: Optional custom list of specific TLDs to check instead of scope.

name: scan_keyword_tlds
title: Scan Keyword TLD Timeline, Coverage Radar & CSV Exporter
